name: Spareribs to Go
description: A versatile spareribs recipe that can be broiled or heated in a glaze sauce, perfect for make-ahead meals.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil spareribs, cut into serving pieces, in salted water for 1½ hours. Drain and place in a shallow dish.
Pour the glaze mixture (garlic and honey) over the ribs. May be frozen for later use.
To finish, remove ribs from the glaze and broil 6 inches from heat in the oven or barbecue until crisp. Alternatively, baste ribs and heat in the sauce.

keywords: spareribs, garlic honey glaze, make-ahead ribs

_similar.name: Maple Glazed Ribs
_similar.description: A sweet and savory pork spare ribs recipe glazed with a maple syrup-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut ribs into serving-size pieces and place in a roasting pan. Cover and bake for 1½ hours or until tender.

Meanwhile, combine the Dijon mustard, maple syrup, Worcestershire sauce, orange juice, curry powder, garlic, ketchup, green onions, and soya sauce in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain the ribs and pour the sauce over them. Bake uncovered for an additional ½ hour, stirring occasionally.

_similar.keywords: maple glazed ribs, pork spare ribs, sweet and savory

_similar.name: Sticky Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish baked in a sticky sauce with pineapple and mushrooms.

recipeInstructions.text: Shake chicken pieces in a bag with flour, paprika, ginger, and garlic powder to coat.
Combine pineapple juice and water to make 1 cup. Add brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce, soya sauce, and drained mushrooms. Mix well.
Place the coated chicken in a pan, skin side down. Pour the sauce over the chicken.
Bake at 350°F, uncovered, for 1 hour. Baste often and turn the chicken at 30 minutes.
During the last 5 minutes, add drained pineapple tidbits and an additional can of drained mushrooms.

_similar.keywords: sticky chicken, baked chicken, pineapple chicken

_similar.name: Thai Chicken
_similar.description: A Thai-inspired chicken dish with spaghetti, vegetables, and a tangy sauce, served hot or chilled.
recipeIngredient: 2 tsp Sambal Oelek or hot pepper sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum time. Drain, rinse with cold water, and drain again.
Stir pasta in a large bowl to coat with sesame oil.
Finely grate the peel from 1 lime and squeeze juice to measure 1/4 cup. Stir juice, peel, soya sauce, hot pepper sauce, salt, and sugar into pasta.
Slice chicken into bite-size pieces, thinly slice pepper, onion, and celery, and julienne carrots.
Stir-fry chicken in batches and return to the pan with garlic and onions. Stir-fry about 3 minutes.
Stir in water, peppers, celery, and carrots. Continue stirring about 3 minutes, adding a bit more water if necessary.
Add snow peas and stir about 1 minute.
Toss with the pasta, serve right away, or chill overnight and serve cold the next day.

_similar.name: Saucy Sausages
_similar.description: A flavorful Oktoberfest sausage dish baked in a rich sauce made with chili sauce, salsa, and spices.

recipeInstructions.text: First, boil sausages until almost done or brown them in a frying pan.
In a separate bowl, combine the barbecue sauce, HP sauce, chili sauce, garlic salt, salsa sauce, seasoning salt, ketchup, and onion powder.
Place the sausages in the bottom of a roasting pan or baking dish. Sprinkle with the three spices (garlic salt, seasoning salt, onion powder). Cover with the sauce mixture.
Cover and bake in a 350 °F oven for approximately ½ hour.
Can be served with rice.

_similar.keywords: Oktoberfest sausages, saucy sausages, baked sausages

_similar.name: Sweet & Sour Pineapple Chicken
_similar.description: A sweet and tangy chicken dish baked in a pineapple-based sauce, perfect for a comforting meal.
recipeIngredient: ⅗ cup (¼ cup + 2 Tbsp) crushed pineapple, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Simmer the chicken breasts in water until cooked through, turning occasionally.
In a pan, combine crushed pineapple, vinegar, brown sugar, salt, ketchup, and water. Cook over heat, stirring until the sauce thickens.
Place the cooked chicken in a casserole dish and pour the sweet and sour sauce over the top.
Cover the dish with tinfoil and bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: sweet and sour chicken, pineapple chicken, baked chicken
